rule: Every missing Harness-owned semantic tool blocks all downstream claims named in claim_blocks.

tools.name: LiveContext and effect boundary
tools.product_role: Resolve repository/worktree roots, candidate identity, digests, configuration, tool/capability versions, permissions, and command effect into one immutable context.
tools.implementation_contract: Pure construction before domain execution; no writes, network, telemetry, or cache mutation. Context ID binds canonical serialized fields and selected live inputs.
tools.proof_requirement: Root ambiguity, nested worktree, symlink, dirty tree, missing tools, unsupported host features, concurrent mutation, and repeatability tests.
tools.retirement_mapping: Remove command-local root/context builders after all consumers migrate.

tools.name: Semantic inventory and authority catalog
tools.product_role: Generate canonical inventories of plugin components, semantic symbols, schemas, fixtures, commands, requirements, generated outputs, and legacy aliases.
tools.implementation_contract: Deterministic generation from source and explicit metadata; handwritten projections are non-authoritative and drift is a finding.
tools.proof_requirement: Deterministic regeneration, omitted/duplicate/renamed component corpus, stale projection detection, and path confinement.
tools.retirement_mapping: Replace plugin-manifest-draft resources, static fixture catalogs, lane registries, and duplicate command inventories.

tools.name: Affected-set graph and verified reuse
tools.product_role: Map semantic changes to a conservative dependency-closed set of checks and bind cache reuse to node semantics, inputs, tool identity, environment, and outputs.
tools.implementation_contract: Unknown edges expand work; cache misses never lower correctness; routine and strict profiles have distinct declared closure rules.
tools.proof_requirement: Mutation comparison against strict runs, cache poisoning, tool/version drift, generated code, rename, feature, platform, and uncertainty cases.
tools.retirement_mapping: Retire static path rules and one-dimensional coverage authority after comparison corpus passes.

tools.name: Command execution and artifact capture
tools.product_role: Execute authorized subprocesses and capture typed argv, cwd, environment allowlist, exit/signal, timing, bounded output, and produced artifacts without interpreting claim success.
tools.implementation_contract: Capture is effect-aware, path-confined, bounded, redacted, and content-addressed. Printed PASS text has no authority.
tools.proof_requirement: Timeout, signal, truncation, non-UTF8, spoofed text, wrong output, symlink, race, redaction, and interruption tests.
tools.retirement_mapping: Migrate command-specific receipt writers/readers through adapters, then remove them.

tools.name: Isolated behavioral fixture scheduler
tools.product_role: Schedule isolated positive, negative, tamper, stale, recovery, and reward-hacking scenarios and generate catalogs from fixture metadata.
tools.implementation_contract: Each fixture declares semantic target, isolation needs, expected behavior/finding/ceiling, cleanup, and independent observer.
tools.proof_requirement: Cross-test file/env/process/port/cache/telemetry/install leakage, cleanup failure, flaky quarantine, and expectation integrity.
tools.retirement_mapping: Delete boolean/marker-only fixtures after behavioral replacements and generated catalog parity.

tools.name: Findings, repair, current state, and next
tools.product_role: Project one typed findings/state graph, compile causal repair, and deterministically select one legal next action.
tools.implementation_contract: Views cannot author state. Inspect/next/diagnose are read-only and emit no telemetry or artifacts unless an explicit output is requested.
tools.proof_requirement: Contradiction, tie, blocked dependency, stale input, unsupported capability, repeated query, and no-op cases.
tools.retirement_mapping: Retire checklists, lane status, duplicate readiness engines, and hand-maintained current-state files.

tools.name: Package, install, and discovery reconciler
tools.product_role: Build deterministic packages and reconcile source, package, marketplace, installed bytes, host discovery, and representative runtime identity without crossing truth surfaces.
tools.implementation_contract: Each adapter declares supported host/version/capabilities; unavailable APIs lower only their claim. External installs require explicit authority.
tools.proof_requirement: Byte mismatch, stale cache, duplicate versions, wrong home/project, registered-hidden, unsupported host, deterministic rebuild, and real new-session task.
tools.retirement_mapping: Environment scripts remain thin adapters; legacy package inventory and install receipts lose authority.

tools.name: Repository fit reconciler
tools.product_role: Inspect desired/current semantic state, plan bounded changes, apply with ownership and rollback, and verify loaded repository behavior.
tools.implementation_contract: One engine supports fresh and retrofit modes; conflicts are explicit; generated ownership and user ownership cannot be conflated.
tools.proof_requirement: Fresh/partial/conflicting repositories, user edits, idempotency, rollback, unsupported host features, and real routine command after fit.
tools.retirement_mapping: Retire separate initializer/retrofit authorities and template-presence success checks.

tools.name: Semantic event store, query, and export
tools.product_role: Emit/query bounded local semantic events, correlate causes, compile explanations, and optionally export approved data with roundtrip reconciliation.
tools.implementation_contract: Local operation is zero-dependency; read queries have no writes; exports are explicit effects; event rows cannot set claim state.
tools.proof_requirement: Roundtrip, corruption, redaction, high-cardinality, duplicate/reorder, exporter failure/delay, and wrong-context tests.
tools.retirement_mapping: Retire receipt-presence telemetry proof and mandatory external-stack assumptions.

tools.name: Evaluation and improvement engine
tools.product_role: Audit tasks, datasets, scorers, traces, contamination, reproducibility, and product artifacts; harvest failures and evaluate scoped changes with rollback.
tools.implementation_contract: Core schemas and promotion rules are vendor-neutral; adapters may run current tools but cannot own law or completion authority.
tools.proof_requirement: Broken task, label/score perturbation, leakage, contamination, non-determinism, grader disagreement, reward hacking, and artifact inspection.
tools.retirement_mapping: Retire score-only promotion and deprecated/vendor-specific top-level command authority.

tools.name: Claim graph and independent reconciliation
tools.product_role: Join laws, requirements, surfaces, behavior, evidence, observations, findings, guards, ceilings, reviewers, and external decisions into one claim authority.
tools.implementation_contract: Claim definitions are adopted independently of implementation. Evidence producers cannot reconcile their own completion-bearing output. Claims bind one LiveContext/candidate identity.
tools.proof_requirement: Contradictory, omitted, stale, wrong-surface, self-authored, tampered, partial, and reviewer-only evidence; independent replay of completion claims.
tools.retirement_mapping: Route legacy final packet, readiness, product, standards, and receipt validators to read-only compatibility views, then remove.

tools.name: Migration router and retirement verifier
tools.product_role: Generate migration plans, compatibility aliases, deprecation findings, active-reference inventories, cleanup operations, and retirement proof.
tools.implementation_contract: Plan is read-only; apply is explicit and reversible where possible; destructive cleanup requires authority; compatibility has an owner, measurement, deadline, and removal condition.
tools.proof_requirement: Alias correctness, deprecation visibility, zero-active-reference checks, generated outputs, rollback, dirty tree, and successor behavior before removal.
tools.retirement_mapping: This tool owns retirement and remains after legacy-specific adapters disappear.
